info.title: gscript 2.0.0-alpha.12 - self-healing, cross-platform git-push + dev-ops ceremony
info.description: Self-healing, cross-platform git-push + dev-ops ceremony tool. Content-shape preflight gates (trailing-null, file-size, structured-file parse, markdown shrinkage, leak-check), localmd PAT auth, stale-lock recovery, retry-on-collision, per-step CI watch, post-deploy probes. The C# successor to the gscript PowerShell module.

options.name: --files
options.description: comma-separated paths to stage (explicit; never `git add .`)

options.name: --message
options.description: commit message

options.name: --no-deploy
options.description: append [skip ci]; skip CI watch + probes

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: push but don't watch CI

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: run gates + divergence check, then stop (no commit/push)

options.name: --no-sync
options.description: disable the pre-push auto-fast-forward when origin advanced disjointly

options.name: --require-clean
options.description: fail if files outside --files are modified/untracked (runner-tree hygiene)

options.name: --max-shrink-pct
options.description: relax file-size + markdown shrink gates to N% for this push

options.name: --allow-shrink
options.description: exempt one path from the shrink gates (repeatable)

options.name: --config
options.description: gscript.json (default: ./gscript.json if present)

options.name: --repo-owner
options.description: override repo owner

options.name: --repo-name
options.description: override repo name

options.name: --workflow
options.description: CI workflow filename (default: deploy.yml)

options.name: --working-dir
options.description: repo root (default: current directory)

options.name: --localmd
options.description: localmd/PAT path (default: %USERPROFILE%\private\local.md; or gscript.json localmdPath/patFile)

options.name: --log
options.description: append a markdown push-log entry per successful push (or gscript.json logFile)

options.name: --help
options.description: this help

options.name: --version
--hub
options.description: the hub CLAUDE.md (default: CLAUDE.md beside gscript.json's localmdPath)

options.name: --budget
options.description: hub line budget (default 450); exceeding it is an ERROR

options.name: --warn-pct
options.description: warn when usage reaches N% of budget (default 90)

options.name: --archived-root
options.description: pre-relocation root to warn on (repeatable; also <hubDir>\im.json archivedRoots)

options.name: --deep
options.description: also stale-path-scan localmd/*.md beside the hub

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
list unverifiable paths (non-C:\work roots, other machines)
lint exits 1 on any error (budget overrun, stale C:\work path, broken `localmd/…` ref)
so it can gate a ceremony; archived-location references are warnings only.
